description: Issue #16 / #17: confirm that the 10% mode share is specification and not a residual small-sample artefact. #17 established that at 1% flow-capacity granularity aborts 1,032 car legs against 4 at 10%, which moved car by ~15 pp and nearly overturned the DECISIONS.md 9.10 conclusion on contaminated evidence. The threshold between 10% and 25% is unmeasured, so the 10% reading is confirmed rather than trusted before a 8.5 departure is logged - a departure cannot be un-logged. 25% is the largest fraction 9.5 measured that leaves headroom on a 63.5 GiB machine. 8 threads matches ride_sufficiency_1pct and ride_sufficiency_10pct exactly; thread count is part of the run identity. NOT A RESULT: 9.7 shows 250 iterations is measurably short of relaxation.
